chapters.title: Sura ya Kwanza: Mwanzo - Chapter One: Beginning

verses.text: Hapo zamani za kale, kulikuwa na msitu mkubwa wenye wanyama wengi. Once upon a time, there was a big forest with many animals.
Wanyama hawa waliishi kwa amani na furaha. These animals lived in peace and happiness.
Lakini siku moja, kitu cha ajabu kilitokea... But one day, something amazing happened...

chapters.title: Sura ya Pili: Tukio - Chapter Two: The Event

verses.text: Wanyama wote walikusanyika pamoja. All the animals gathered together.
Walikuwa na mkutano muhimu. They had an important meeting.
Kila mmoja alitoa wazo lake. Everyone shared their idea.

chapters.title: Sura ya Tatu: Mwisho - Chapter Three: The End

verses.text: Baada ya mazungumzo mengi, wanyama walifika uamuzi. After much discussion, the animals reached a decision.
Wote walikubaliana kufanya kazi pamoja. They all agreed to work together.
Na kuanzia siku hiyo, msitu ulikuwa mahali bora zaidi. And from that day, the forest became an even better place.
